nodes.label: The core is the knowledge graph, its tools and its deploy; frameworks and domains are packs
nodes.summary: OTO's core is the knowledge graph's lifecycle with its tools, the estate and the reified model it is described in, and the deploy of the graph; an architecture framework is a pack plus an adapter, and a domain feature is a pack plus its tools, loaded only when the pack is composed in the project.
